channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Buccaneers at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: DET -6.5 · O/U 46.5 | Model DET 74% vs. market 73% | The game turns on whether Tampa Bay can stay efficient through the air against a Detroit pass rush that ranks 3rd, since the Buccaneers already grade worst in EPA per dropback at -0.25. Baker Mayfield posts -1.26 EPA per dropback under pressure, and he faces a Lions rush that gets there on 23% of dropbacks. Our model puts Detroit at 74%, close to the market's 73%, and the quarterback gap drives most of that number.
